description: Update cvrt-order-fulfillment settings. Only provide the keys you want to change; omitted keys keep their stored value. Secrets are write-only: a blank/omitted secret keeps the stored value (never wipes it), the literal "__clear" deletes it. Returns the settings as fulfillment_get_settings does (secrets as { set }).

agent_token.description: Bearer token the print agent authenticates with. Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

clickup_assignee_id.description: ClickUp user id the tasks are assigned to

clickup_list_id.description: ClickUp list id the fulfillment tasks are created in

clickup_token.description: ClickUp API token. Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

github_updater_token.description: GitHub token for plugin updates (falls back to the GITHUB_UPDATER_TOKEN constant). Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

slack_bot_token.description: Slack bot token (xoxb-...), enables threads and reactions; needs slack_channel_id. Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

slack_channel_id.description: Slack channel id the bot token posts to

slack_webhook_url.description: Slack incoming-webhook URL, the fallback when no bot token is set. Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

webhook_secret.description: Webhook secret. Write-only (returned as { set }); blank or omitted keeps the stored value, "__clear" deletes it

name: fulfillment_update_settings
